name: Confidential analytics sandbox
description: docker_api-suitable analytics profile for the Agentic Data Scientist and data-scientist turns. No network, allowlist only (pandas · numpy · scipy · scikit-learn · pyarrow · openpyxl), 2 vCPU / 1 536 MiB / 300 s / 32 MiB output / 20 artifacts / 1 concurrent per run. Runs data up to confidential. A root profile beside public-dev (wider limits than public-dev, so it cannot be its child — a child may only narrow); dsk-analytics (gVisor) is the ceiling for real deployments.
